text: Nearby Enemies have Lightning Resistance equal to yours.
translation: 附近敌人的闪电抗性与你相同。
次要异常状态持续时间

text: The Tank class outlasts enemies through sheer durability and offense.
translation: 坦克职业凭借纯粹的耐久与攻势拖垮敌人。

text: The Mercenary is puts itself at risk for a greater power.
translation: 雇佣兵将自己置于险境，以换取更强大的力量。

text: The Warlock defeats it's opponents with it's knowledge of Poison.
translation: 术士凭借对毒素的学识击败对手。

text: Cast a surge of lightning towards an enemy, chaining to multiple enemies.
translation: 向一名敌人施放一道闪电奔涌，并连锁至多名敌人。

text: Tether yourself to nearby enemies, dealing damage to them. Enemies affected by Flame Tethers deal 25% Less Damage.
translation: 将自身与附近敌人链接，对其造成伤害。受烈焰链接影响的敌人造成25%更少伤害。

text: Tether yourself to nearby enemies, periodically causing damage. If the enemy is cursed, then Doom Tether will deal 50% More Damage for each Curse on the enemy, and deal damage in an area.
translation: 将自身与附近敌人链接，周期性造成伤害。若敌人被诅咒，末日链接会基于敌人身上的每个诅咒造成50%更多伤害，并在范围内造成伤害。

text: Cast a volatile ball of ice at a nearby enemy, which releases shards in random directions, having a high chance to Freeze. Extra projectiles affect the number of released shards. Shards cannot pierce or chain.
translation: 向附近的一名敌人施放不稳定的冰球，冰球会向随机方向释放碎片，有很高几率冰冻敌人。额外投射物会影响释放的碎片数量。碎片无法穿透或连锁。

text: Sparks shock nearby enemies, dealing more damage to closer enemies.
translation: 火花使附近敌人感电，距离越近的敌人受到的伤害越多。

text: Summon an ethereal Blade to protect you, dealing Physical Damage to enemies hit by the blade. Blade Shield is unaffected by Cast Speed. Extra Projectiles reduce the cooldown instead.
translation: 召唤一把虚幻利刃守护你，对利刃命中的敌人造成物理伤害。利刃护盾不受施法速度影响。额外投射物改为减少冷却时间。

text: Throws a cluster of charged bombs which detonates, dealing damage in an area.
translation: 投掷一簇充能炸弹，引爆后在范围内造成伤害。

text: Poison an enemy for a duration.
translation: 使敌人中毒，持续一段时间。

text: Skill has a higher chance to deal critical strikes.
translation: 技能有更高几率造成暴击。

text: Skill deals more damage with Bleeds and Ruptures, and has a higher chance to inflict Bleeds.
translation: 技能的流血与破裂造成更多伤害，且有更高几率施加流血。

text: Skill deals more damage with Poisons and Infections, and has a higher chance to inflict Poisons.
translation: 技能的中毒与感染造成更多伤害，且有更高几率施加中毒。

text: Skill converts some Physical damage into Lightning Damage
translation: 技能将部分物理伤害转化为闪电伤害
技能造成更多闪电伤害

text: Physical Damage with skill penetrates Physical Resistance on enemies.
translation: 技能的物理伤害穿透敌人的物理抗性。

text: Toxic Damage with skill penetrates Toxic Resistance on enemies.
translation: 技能的毒素伤害穿透敌人的毒素抗性。
基于物理伤害的额外火焰伤害

text: Convert a portion of Lightning Damage into Toxic Damage
translation: 将部分闪电伤害转化为毒素伤害

text: Skill has a chance to inflict Exposure on hit, with increased effect.
translation: 技能命中时有几率施加曝露，且效果增加。

text: Bleeds and Ruptures inflicted by this skill have increased effect.
translation: 此技能施加的流血与破裂效果增加。

text: Poisons and Infections inflicted by this skill have increased effect.
translation: 此技能施加的中毒与感染效果增加。

text: Skill has a 30% chance to cast when another skill inflicts a killing blow. Skill does not auto cast, and cannot trigger other skills. All Triggered skills have a 100ms cooldown.
translation: 当其他技能造成致命一击时，此技能有30%几率施放。此技能不会自动施放，也无法触发其他技能。所有被触发的技能有100ms冷却时间。

text: Chance to gain Precision Boon on Crit
translation: 暴击时获得精准赐福的几率

text: Chance to gain Toughness Boon on Kill
translation: 击杀时获得坚韧赐福的几率

text: Increased Area of Effect per Precision Boon
translation: 每个精准赐福增加作用范围

text: Life Regeneration per second Per Wisdom
translation: 每点智慧每秒生命再生

text: Damage Over Time Multiplier per Precision Boon
translation: 每个精准赐福持续伤害倍率

text: Physical Damage Converted to Cold Damage
translation: 物理伤害转化为冰冷伤害

text: Lightning Damage Converted to Fire Damage
translation: 闪电伤害转化为火焰伤害

text: Fire Damage Converted to Toxic Damage
translation: 火焰伤害转化为毒素伤害

text: Physical Damage as Extra Added Toxic Damage
translation: 物理伤害额外附加毒素伤害

text: Cold Damage as Extra Added Fire Damage
translation: 冰冷伤害额外附加火焰伤害

text: Physical Damage taken as Cold Damage
translation: 受到的物理伤害视为冰冷伤害

text: Lightning Damage taken as Fire Damage
translation: 受到的闪电伤害视为火焰伤害

text: Fire Damage taken as Toxic Damage
translation: 受到的火焰伤害视为毒素伤害

text: The best offense is a good defense.
translation: 最好的进攻就是稳固的防御。

text: It's not much, but it'll do for now.
translation: 虽然不多，但暂时够用了。

text: When the wind catches a small flame, a forest is needed to put it out.
translation: 当风助燃一簇小火苗时，需要整片森林才能将其扑灭。

text: Sometimes, just sometimes, tinkering with a bomb isn't dangerous.
translation: 有时候，只是有时候，摆弄炸弹并不危险。

text: Memories of trauma linger amongst the survivors.
translation: 创伤的记忆在幸存者之间萦绕不散。

text: Reminders of the skill you possess.
translation: 提醒着你所掌握的技艺。

text: Skill casts when another skill inflicts a critical strike. Skill does not auto cast, and cannot trigger other skills.
translation: 当其他技能造成暴击时，施放此技能。此技能不会自动施放，也无法触发其他技能。

text: Elemental Ailments inflicted by this Skill also apply to nearby enemies.
translation: 此技能施加的元素异常状态也会施加于附近的敌人。

text: Skills have a 10% chance to apply Exposed on Hit
translation: 技能命中时有10%几率施加曝露

text: Take 90% Less Damage from hits if you have not been hit in the past 5 seconds.
translation: 若你在过去5秒内未被击中，受到命中时承受90%更少伤害。

text: Gain 25% More Movement Speed for 5 seconds when hit
translation: 被击中时获得25%更多移动速度，持续5秒

text: Recover 1% of Maximum Life when you kill an enemy.
translation: 击杀敌人时回复1%最大生命。

text: Enemies take 10% More Damage for each curse on them
translation: 敌人身上每个诅咒使其承受10%更多伤害

text: Skills have 30% More Area of Effect
translation: 技能拥有30%更多作用范围

text: Gain 25% Increased Movement Speed for 1 seconds when you are hit
translation: 被击中时移动速度增加25%，持续1秒

text: 65% Less Maximum Life, 10% More Cast Speed, 25% More Damage
translation: 65%更少最大生命，10%更多施法速度，25%更多伤害
冰缓的敌人承受15%更多伤害

text: 50% chance to cast an extra Bomb
All Weapons that drop are Caster Weapons.
translation: 所有掉落的武器都是法杖武器。

text: Bleeds and Ruptures apply as Fire Damage. Bleeding Enemies have -25% Physical and Fire Resistance.
translation: 流血与破裂视为火焰伤害。流血的敌人拥有-25%物理与火焰抗性。

text: Attack Skills also count as Spell Skills. Spell Skills also count as Attack Skills.
translation: 攻击技能也视为法术技能。法术技能也视为攻击技能。

text: You take 1% Less Damage per 30 Wisdom, up to 30% Less Damage Taken.
translation: 每30点智慧使你承受1%更少伤害，最多承受30%更少伤害。

text: If two Melee Weapons are equipped, gain 30% More Cast Speed, 20% More Damage, and take 20% Less Damage.
translation: 若装备两把近战武器，获得30%更多施法速度、20%更多伤害，并承受20%更少伤害。

text: Gain 1% Increased Physical Damage for every 250 Total Armor, up to 5000%.
translation: 每250点总护甲使你增加1%物理伤害，最多5000%。

text: Burns on enemies proliferate to up to 5 nearby non-burning enemies when the burning enemy dies.
translation: 灼烧的敌人死亡时，灼烧会扩散至最多5名附近未灼烧的敌人。

text: Gain a Toughness Boon every 3 seconds.
translation: 每3秒获得一个坚韧赐福。

text: Hits have a 10% chance to inflict Echoing for 250ms. Inflicting Echoing causes nearby Enemies to take 140% of the Hit Damage. Damage from Echoing can inflict Echoing. Echoing cannot be inflicted against Enemies affected by Echoing.
translation: 命中有10%几率施加回响，持续250ms。施加回响会使附近敌人承受140%的命中伤害。回响造成的伤害也能施加回响。无法对已受回响影响的敌人施加回响。
玩家获得25%更多移动速度

text: Are you sure? This cannot be undone.
translation: 确定吗？此操作无法撤销。
